findings.location: he musaf_uppad_meaz.xml, stanza 5: <j:conditional xml:id="musaf_uppad_meaz_segment_5"> … <tei:note role/reader>ח׳</tei:note> קֶרֶן בְּמָשְׁכָם <j:endConditional/>
findings.problem: The reader label ח׳ sits inside the weekday-only conditional (shabbat=false). On Shabbat the label drops out, so the Shabbat line קֶרֶן בְּזָכְרָם has no speaker and the reader's part appears to belong to the congregation. The label is printed before the alternation, so it belongs to both readings. The rest of the F3 pair is correct: both readings are exclusive and binary, the Shabbat one is marked with its instruction, and English 'blow'/'remember' mirrors them.
findings.fix: Move the ח׳ description note (with its abbr/expan) to just before <j:conditional xml:id="musaf_uppad_meaz_segment_5">, so the conditional holds only קֶרֶן בְּמָשְׁכָם. Re-run the actual selector assertions for shabbat true, false and undecided.

findings.location: he musaf_misod_chakhamim.xml, second j:option 'פני מלך מלכי המלכים מלא רחמים'
findings.problem: The page prints נ״א פני ממ״ה מלא רחמים, and the human confirmed ממ״ה = מלך מלכי המלכים. The selectable reading, however, writes the expansion out unpointed as plain recited text. The printed abbreviation survives only in the standOff note, so a build that selects this option shows text the page does not print, with nothing marking it as an expansion.
findings.fix: Inside the option, write פני <tei:choice><tei:abbr>ממ״ה</tei:abbr><tei:expan>מלך מלכי המלכים</tei:expan></tei:choice> מלא רחמים, or record the expansion as editorial. Do not change the words.

findings.location: standOff notes in he musaf_misod_chakhamim.xml and musaf_shofarot_close.xml (target=…/text)
findings.problem: These variant notes point at the whole prayer-part, not at the word where the variant is printed. Uppad's note at least targets stanza 6. Each variant is also encoded a second time as a j:option, so a build with paratext turned on may show it twice.
findings.fix: Put an xml:id on each tei:choice holding the options and target the note there. If the project wants both encodings, check that the exporter suppresses one of them.

findings.problem: On s200, 'תְּפִלַּת מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה' sits between two '90' page numbers, which makes it the running head, not a section title. As tei:head it duplicates the spine's head 'תפלת מוסף'. The English 'Musaph for the New Year' is probably the same case. (This was left unadjudicated in the first report.)
findings.fix: Encode it as tei:fw type="header", or drop it if running heads are not kept, after checking s201 for the English. Leave the section title to the spine head.

findings.problem: On s200 the small speaker label before יתגדל looks abbreviated (חז׳-like), but it is encoded as full חזן with no abbr. F11 handled the Uppad labels differently. I am not certifying this reading.
findings.fix: The human should confirm the printed form. If it is abbreviated, use tei:choice abbr/expan חזן as in F11.

findings.location: he musaf_useir_lekhapper.xml idno/div corresp urn:…/musaf/offering_formula/useir_lekhapper vs milestone …/offering_formula/ushenei_seirim
findings.problem: The Frankfurt alternate is a separate document whose URN sits under another document's path, while its sibling ushenei_seirim is a milestone inside that document. The resolver could read offering_formula/useir_lekhapper as a missing part of offering_formula instead of a document in its own right.
findings.fix: Either make the URN a sibling (…/musaf/useir_lekhapper, and update the spine transclude), or confirm that validate_urn_references and the transclusion resolver look for an exact document match first.

findings.location: en musaf_uppad_meaz.xml ('witnesses  [blow ][remember ] the'); he musaf_malkhuyot_close.xml/musaf_vattitten_lanu.xml segment joins
findings.problem: Trailing spaces inside the conditional content, plus whitespace around the conditionals, leave double spaces in the output, e.g. 'witnesses  blow  the'. The words are correct; this is cosmetic only.
findings.fix: Keep one space outside the conditional pair and none inside.
